description: Set the social media accounts associated with a specific post.

accountIds.description: Array of social account IDs to associate with the post

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

postId.description: The social post ID to assign accounts to
